description: Current DNS records for a hostname from Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS: A, AAAA, CNAME chain, MX with priority and null-MX flag, NS, TXT (up to 25 records of at most 400 characters, email addresses redacted), CAA as flag, tag and value, and SOA primary nameserver, serial and timers, each with its minimum TTL. An optional type parameter limits the answer to one record type. For subdomains without their own zone, NS and SOA come from the registrable domain. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

domain.description: Bare domain, hostname, email address or URL. Scheme, path, port and credentials are stripped and IDNs are converted to punycode. IP addresses and private names are rejected.

type.description: One record type to return instead of all of them (case-insensitive).

name: domain_dns
title: DNS records for a domain
